records.title: Hasty investigation of Ahmedabad plane crash
details: (a) to (d) It was inter-alia stated that the investigation is ongoing and will examine all the aspects to determine the probable cause(s)/ contributory factor(s) leading to the accident. The sole objective of the investigation of an accident or incident shall be the prevention of accidents and incidents and not to apportion blame or liability.
